prs.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
prs.author: Genmin
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' (without also requiring 'text/event-stream'), returning a 406 error. prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only 'application/json' (without also requiring 'text/event-stream'), returning a 406 error. Both PRs relax this validation in the same POST handler of webStandardStreamableHttp.ts. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 introduces a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that correctly parses the Accept header per HTTP semantics: case-insensitive matching, media-type wildcard support (e.g. '*/*' or 'application/*'), and honors q=0 to exclude explicitly disallowed types. #2046 instead uses a direct substring '.includes("application/json")' check, which is simpler but doesn't handle q=0 exclusions or wildcards, and is vulnerable to false-positive substring matches (e.g. 'application/json-patch+json' would satisfy '.includes("application/json")'). Both touch the exact same validation block at the same lines in src/server/webStandardStreamableHttp.ts.
